name: Lofoten
oneLineFragment: Arctic fjord winter cabins and cod drying racks in the sea wind.
narrativeStory:
Salt spray freezing on black volcanic shingles before midday. The mountains rear straight out of the Norwegian Sea, their granite faces cloaked in powder and sea mist.

In Reine and Hamnøy, red rorbuer sit on weathered stilts over slate-green tidepools. Here the silence is interrupted only by the creak of timber and the distant crash of the Arctic swell.
subtitle: Arctic Archipelago • Norwegian Sea
introLines: Salt spray freezing on black volcanic shingles.
Granite peaks shearing through low maritime cloud.
Nine frames exposed in the twilight of 68 degrees north.

frames.caption: Arctic fjord winter cabins on weathered timber stilts
Wooden cod drying racks standing empty against the gale
Haukland beach turquoise surf breaking on snowbank
Aurora borealis curtain unfurling over Olstinden peak
